reader.requirement: At --std 85 a DELETE on a relative file (every access mode) that is not open in the I-O mode (never opened, open INPUT, open OUTPUT, closed, or after a failed OPEN) is unsuccessful with I-O status 49 and is not an invalid key, and DELETE on a file that is not a mass storage file with Relative/Indexed organization is not admitted.

edition-consulted.switches: below 2002 an INVALID KEY phrase or applicable USE is required on a random/dynamic DELETE (§1985:VIII.4.3.3 SR2); not this rule's behaviour

reader.edition-search: grep Edition/DialectLevel/DialectBehavior/CobolVersion in RelativeConnector.Delete, FileConnector.MutationOpenModeGuard and PermanentErrorReplay, KeyedIoEmitter.EmitDelete and KeyedIoBinder.BindDelete: the open-mode guard reads IsOpen and Mode only; the runtime Edition property is read only by SharingFacilityInEffect and the relative WRITE key-range behaviour
reader.behaviour-differs-by-edition: no: 49 for every non-I-O state at 85 and 2023 alike
reader.witnesses-cover: part: g85_bf30_03 covers only DELETE on a file open INPUT (dynamic access); not never-opened, OUTPUT, closed, after a failed OPEN, random access, sequential access

probes.printed: NOTOPEN 49 / OUTPUT 49 / INPUT 49 / IO 00 / CLOSED 49 / SEQ-INPUT 49 / OPEN-M 35 then MISSING 49; each 49 runs the USE procedure and no INVALID KEY line; identical at --std 2023
probes.expected: 49 (VIII.1.3.4 GRL2.5h) whenever the file is not open in the I-O mode; 00 in I-O

probes.printed: error COBOL0865: DELETE RECORD shall not be specified for sequential-organization file 'SQ' (ISO §2023:14.9.10.3 SR1)
probes.expected: refused: DELETE is not a Sequential I-O module statement at 1985

citations.check: OK  §1985:VIII.4.3.4 GR1  (4.3.4 General Rules)  the text is in GR1
OK  §1985:VIII.1.3.4  (1.3.4 I-O Status)  the text is in the clause; it lies in GRL2.5h

reader.notes: The seed IndexedConnector#Delete is the indexed organization; the relative arm is RelativeConnector#Delete through the shared MutationOpenModeGuard. After OPEN I-O fails with 35, a DELETE answers 49, not a replayed 35: the connector is not open, and VIII.1.3.4 lets the implementor choose when several values apply. The sequential-organization refusal cites the 2023 clause at --std 85 (a citation detail, not this rule).

refuter.evidence: Probe refute-1985-131/d56.cob (runs/d56-001, --std 85): a relative file in sequential access opened EXTEND (the 1985 open mode only that access mode admits, §1985:VIII.4.4.3 SR1) answers DELETE with 'EXT-DEL 49' and runs the USE procedure; the reader covered never-opened, OUTPUT, INPUT, closed and failed-OPEN. dnr.cob (runs/dnr-001): the 1985 format's optional RECORD word omitted, 'DELETE FA INVALID KEY ... END-DELETE' compiles and deletes ('D1 00', then 'D2 IK 23'). RelativeConnector.Delete reaches MutationOpenModeGuard before anything else and consults no edition. cite.py: OK §1985:VIII.4.3.4 GR1 (the text is in GR1); OK §1985:VIII.4.4.3 SR1 (the text is in SR1). The sequential-organization refusal COBOL0865 citing §2023:14.9.10.3 SR1 at --std 85 is a citation-edition detail, not this rule's behaviour.
